description: This Swift file defines a SwiftUI view called OpenClawChatComposer, which provides a chat message input interface with features such as toolbar controls, attachments, and integration with different platforms (macOS and iOS). It also includes supporting code for text input and image paste support on macOS.

classes.name: ChatComposerTextView
classes.description: A macOS-specific NSViewRepresentable wrapper for a custom NSTextView subclass used for message input, supporting send on return and image pasting.

classes.name: ChatComposerNSTextView
classes.description: A custom NSTextView subclass to handle key events, pasteboard interactions, and image pastes in the chat input on macOS.

classes.name: ChatComposerPasteSupport
classes.description: A utility enum providing methods to support pasting images and file references from the pasteboard.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates a coordinator object to bridge NSTextViewDelegate functions.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates the NSScrollView containing the custom NSTextView.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSTextView with new text and focus state.

methods.name: pickFilesMac
methods.description: Opens a native file picker dialog on macOS for selecting image files.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles file drops onto the chat input area on macOS.

methods.name: loadPhotosPickerItems
methods.description: Loads and processes images selected via PhotosPicker on iOS.
